desc: Parse input and reject immediately when the original length difference exceeds \(K\).
Trim common prefix/suffix and exploit Levenshtein symmetry by using the longer string as the row dimension.
Implement rolling-row banded Levenshtein DP with \(O(K)\) memory.
Handle insertion, deletion, and replacement transitions with band sentinels.
Guard the diagonal replacement transition at `j == 0`, including when the trimmed target is empty.
Verify public samples and relevant edge cases.
